stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance to transformers, Llama architecture, and the ML ecosystem.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and features native DFlash and image input support via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: Tesla gave up the EV crown. Now it wants to win the autonomy race
stories.author: Kana Inagaki, Financial Times
bullet_points: Tesla is shifting strategic focus from dominating the EV market to leading the autonomous driving sector.
The company is banking on revenue generated from autonomy subscriptions to compensate for potential margin pressures in vehicle sales.
This signals a significant industry pivot where software and AI capabilities are becoming a primary driver of automotive profitability.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on the Hugging Face platform.
The model is categorized for text-generation tasks, indicating its primary function as a large language model (LLM).
Key associated technologies include transformers and safetensors, standard components in modern NLP/AI.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The model is associated with key technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now available via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter (3B active) open model designed for persistent agents.
The model is optimized for multi-step tasks, context gathering, and tool calling on local hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Five weird details from Anthropic’s IPO filing
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: Anthropic has officially filed its S-1 prospectus with the SEC, signaling an impending IPO.
The filing provides detailed insights into the company's financials, executive compensation, and spending plans.
The document outlines key business risks associated with Anthropic's ambitions in the AI sector.

stories.title: Instagram chases YouTube with a push for longer, widescreen videos
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Instagram is significantly expanding its video offerings to include longform, horizontal (widescreen) content.
This strategic move positions Instagram as a direct competitor to YouTube in the long-form video space.
The shift represents a notable change in platform strategy, as Instagram leadership previously expressed reservations about longform video.

stories.title: Updated Google privacy policy says your Gmail might be used for advertising
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Google's updated privacy policy allows Gmail data to be used for advertising.
The 'Personal Intelligence' feature enables Google to collect more user data for ad targeting.
This represents a significant shift in how Google leverages user communication data for monetization.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO filing, LLM price cuts, vLLM tool calls and a skin cancer CNN: what the sources say
stories.author: axrisi
bullet_points: Anthropic's IPO filing provides insight into the major AI player's financial trajectory.
The industry is seeing significant shifts with LLM price reductions from major providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
Technical advancements are noted, specifically the vLLM tool call fix improving open-model functionality.

stories.title: Speech models in Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has expanded its capabilities to include support for speech models.
The initial supported model is Phonon from Gradium, enabling text-to-speech functionality.
The feature offers fast, real-time streaming of speech in multiple languages, demonstrating high performance on Apple Silicon.

stories.title: Clef is available on Ollama's cloud
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Clef, a 27B multimodal decision model from Cloudflare, is now integrated with Ollama.
Users have the option to run the Clef model either locally or via Ollama's cloud service.
This integration expands the capabilities of Ollama by adding a powerful, large-scale multimodal model.

stories.title: Reflection's Beam is freely available on Ollama for a limited time
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Reflection has released its first open-weight model, Beam, available via Ollama.
Beam is specifically engineered for software engineering, reasoning, and complex agentic tasks.
The model is currently offered for free access on Ollama Cloud for a limited duration.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the deployment of AI agents using its cloud models.
The integration allows these AI agents to run securely within Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for safe and scalable deployment of AI agents in the cloud.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has expanded its capabilities to support decision models.
These new models leverage TypeSafe's Jev API for fast, typed decision-making.
The feature allows models to answer yes/no questions, choices, and scores with associated probabilities at low latency and no cost.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to leverage open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-weight model ecosystems.

stories.title: Apple acknowledges iPhone Duo display ‘issue’ after reports of cracked screens
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Apple has officially acknowledged a display issue affecting a small number of iPhone Duo units.
The reported defect involves cracked or broken inner screens, sometimes exhibiting a bright line.
The issue was brought to light following user reports, prompting Apple's public statement.

stories.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to 60,000 employees
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to up to 60,000 employees.
The layoffs/buyouts span multiple international locations, including the US, UK, Canada, and India.
The move is part of a broader company effort to trim staff, providing financial support and career planning resources to departing staff.

stories.title: A 1,000-mile cloud on Mars may reveal physics never seen in nature
stories.author: Tereza Ondráčková, wired.com
bullet_points: A new scientific model suggests Mars could possess unique ice-forming physics.
The potential discovery relates to phenomena never directly observed in natural settings.
The research points toward the possibility of a large-scale, '1,000-mile cloud' on Mars.

stories.title: NASA updates lander plans for Moon landings, finally solves long-festering Orion issue
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: NASA is updating its lander plans for future Moon missions.
A long-standing technical issue concerning the Orion spacecraft has reportedly been resolved.
The project has secured necessary mandates, resources, and stakeholder support.

stories.title: Hegseth warns prediction market bets warp military judgment, endanger troops
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A Pentagon memo warns that insider trading related to prediction markets could compromise military operations.
The risk identified is that adversaries could gain critical intelligence on US military activities.
The warning suggests that speculative betting markets may negatively influence military judgment.

stories.title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
stories.author: Shenji Wan
bullet_points: SceneBloom is a new agentic framework designed to generate realistic and diverse indoor environments for embodied AI learning.
It addresses the challenge of precise spatial grounding by combining visual layout sampling with contract-guided 3D scene generation.
The research aims to improve generalizable embodied agents by providing high-quality, simulation-ready training data.

stories.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
stories.author: Laixi Shi
bullet_points: Introduces RobustRLlib, a unified library and benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Addresses key limitations in current robust RL: low algorithm reusability and unclear empirical capability boundaries.
Integrates 17 representative robust online RL algorithms to facilitate broader research and deployment.

stories.title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
stories.author: Haozhi Qi
bullet_points: DexPort is a new portable interface designed to solve the bottleneck of collecting high-quality data for dexterous manipulation.
It addresses limitations of traditional methods: teleoperation requires complex setups, while human demonstrations require estimation and retargeting.
The tool aims to directly record executable robot actions in a user-friendly, handheld manner.

stories.title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
stories.author: Zhongliang Jiang
bullet_points: Introduces HAD-VLM, a hybrid framework designed to bridge the gap between discrete token prediction and continuous numerical measurements in medical imaging.
Addresses a key limitation in current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when dealing with quantitative data from modalities like ultrasound.
Utilizes a combination of autoregressive text generation and diffusion modeling, enhanced by visual prompt tuning for medical image adaptation.

stories.title: Monetizing Intelligence: Advertising and Subscription Design on LLM Platforms
stories.author: Tianjun Feng
bullet_points: Examines the economic trade-offs for LLM platforms integrating advertising and subscription models.
Models a monopolistic platform balancing response quality, ad intensity, and subscription pricing.
Suggests that advertising revenue can potentially finance useful service features when mixed plans exist.

stories.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
stories.author: Armon Rasooli
bullet_points: Introduces Yalda Embedding, a new competitive dense retrieval model specifically for the Persian language.
The model is adapted from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and trained on over one million query-document pairs.
It achieves the highest macro-average among evaluated 0.6B models on eight Persian retrieval tasks from FaMTEB.

stories.title: Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
stories.author: Bernhard Bauer
bullet_points: The paper empirically challenges the assumption that performance-optimized code generated by LLMs is inherently energy-efficient.
It evaluates whether LLM self-refinement pipelines result in code that is energy-efficient compared to human-written benchmarks.
The research also investigates the energy cost associated with the LLM optimization process itself.

stories.title: NgramRL: Accelerating RL Post-Training for Structured Generation via Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding
stories.author: Tajana Rosing
bullet_points: NgramRL addresses the high computational cost (over 70% of training time) of RL post-training for LLMs.
It introduces a novel approach using Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding to accelerate the process.
The method aims to overcome limitations of existing speculative decoding techniques, such as GPU memory consumption and policy misalignment.

stories.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
stories.author: Laixi Shi
bullet_points: Introduces RobustRLlib, a unified library and benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning (RL).
Addresses key limitations in current robust RL: limited algorithm reusability and unclear empirical boundaries.
Integrates 17 representative robust online RL algorithms to facilitate broader research and deployment.

stories.title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
stories.author: Haozhi Qi
bullet_points: DexPort introduces a portable interface designed to solve the bottleneck of collecting high-quality data for dexterous manipulation.
It addresses limitations of existing methods: teleoperation requires complex robot setups, while human demonstrations lack direct robot action data.
The technology aims to bridge the gap by providing a convenient way to capture executable robot actions using human input in a mobile setting.

stories.title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
stories.author: Egor Bondarev
bullet_points: Flownomaly addresses few-shot anomaly detection in industrial settings by modeling category-specific normality.
The method reframes the problem as normal-counterpart recovery within the frozen DINOv2 feature space.
It utilizes conditional flow matching over patch tokens to learn a velocity field, guiding noise toward normal representations.

stories.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
stories.author: Federico Lucca
bullet_points: Addresses a critical, often unmeasured problem in personal AI agents: the lack of objective ground truth for training data.
Introduces 'Foyer,' a self-hosted personal inbox agent, and a rigorous measurement protocol to establish ground truth before training.
Compares typed decision models against a classical baseline and a Generative LLM for complex inbox routing tasks.

stories.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Ruosong Wang
bullet_points: The paper addresses instability in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Models (LLMs) caused by discrepancies between inference and training systems.
It proposes a novel solution: stabilizing BF16 RL by aligning only specific, critical parts of the execution stack, rather than the entire stack.
This offers a potentially more targeted and less computationally intensive alternative to existing methods like global precision changes or full stack alignment.

stories.title: If at First You Don't Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
stories.author: Thierry Tambe
bullet_points: Addresses the brittleness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models when encountering out-of-distribution states during robotic manipulation.
Introduces 'Backtrack,' a lightweight mechanism for failure detection and recovery in frozen VLAs.
The method avoids traditional costly solutions like recovery demonstrations or full policy retraining.

stories.title: Learning Positive Linear Combinations of ReLUs in Fully Polynomial Time
stories.author: Nikos Zarifis
bullet_points: The research addresses the PAC learning problem for positive linear combinations of ReLU activations in $\mathbb{R}^d$.
It presents the first algorithm capable of solving this learning task in fully polynomial time.
The algorithm's complexity is polynomial in the dimension ($d$), number of activations ($k$), and inverse error ($\epsilon$).

stories.title: ZENO: Nonlinear filtering with Zakai Equation Neural Operators
stories.author: Brian DePasquale
bullet_points: The research addresses the difficult problem of state inference and parameter learning in nonlinear filtering.
It focuses on solving the Zakai equation, a complex Stochastic Partial Differential Equation (SPDE) governing the unnormalized filtering distribution.
The proposed method, ZENO, utilizes Neural Operators to tackle the high-dimensional nature of these SPDEs, relevant to scientific ML in engineering and neuroscience.

stories.title: The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
stories.author: James E. Dobson
bullet_points: The paper proposes that instruction-fine-tuned language models operate within a specific 'instructional-conversational genre'.
This genre is defined as a blend of discursive language derived from recursive interactions between humans and generative models.
The instantiation of this genre is achieved through instruction fine-tuning, system prompts, and formalized input structures.

stories.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
stories.author: Federico Lucca
bullet_points: Introduces 'Foyer,' a self-hosted personal multilingual inbox agent designed for message routing decisions.
Addresses a critical gap in AI evaluation by proposing a rigorous measurement protocol to establish ground truth *before* training.
Compares typed decision models against a classical baseline and a generative LLM for inbox triage tasks.

stories.title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
stories.author: Armon Rasooli
bullet_points: Introduces Yalda Embedding, a new Persian retrieval model designed to address resource limitations in the language.
The model is an adaptation of Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, trained on over one million query-document pairs.
It achieves the highest macro-average among evaluated 0.6B models on eight Persian retrieval tasks from FaMTEB.

stories.title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
stories.author: Jin Qi
bullet_points: The research investigates 'Complement Consistency' within LLM-agent opinion simulations.
The core hypothesis is that if an agent's opinion is represented by a probability $p$, its complementary opinion should be $1-p$.
The study tests whether rewriting a claim as its complement and inverting all probabilities maintains this consistency in the simulation dynamics.

stories.title: J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents
stories.author: Saman Halgamuge
bullet_points: Introduces J-Comm, a framework designed to enable latent communication between Large Language Model (LLM) agents.
Features GEAR (Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning), a training-free method that reweights token candidates to optimize geometric consensus in embedding space.
Addresses the need for an interface allowing external models to leverage the intermediate reasoning computations of LLMs.

stories.title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
stories.author: Constantin Venhoff
bullet_points: Addresses the critical security vulnerability of model backdoors introduced by poisoned training data.
Introduces TopKLoRA, an interpretable variant of LoRA for parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
Aims to enable 'faithful circuit discovery' by making fine-tuning changes transparent and localizable.

stories.title: Communicating with the Entire Population: Machine Translation of Emergency Alerts and Warnings
stories.author: William D. Lewis
bullet_points: The research addresses the critical need for multilingual communication during emergencies to reach all affected populations.
It investigates the reliability and quality of commercial Machine Translation tools used by emergency response managers.
The study involves a nationwide survey of emergency managers to gauge their experiences with automated translation in crisis situations.

stories.title: SIMD-accelerated computer vision on a $2 microcontroller
stories.author: zdw
bullet_points: Achieving SIMD-accelerated computer vision on a low-cost microcontroller.
Demonstrates significant computational capability in resource-constrained edge devices.
Indicates a trend toward deploying complex AI/ML models on embedded hardware.

stories.title: About the compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs
stories.author: support.apple.com via freddyb
bullet_points: The news concerns the compromise of intermediate Certificate Authorities (CAs) belonging to eMudhra.
This is a significant cybersecurity incident affecting digital trust and authentication systems.
The source, Lobsters, suggests a technical discussion around the implications of the CA compromise.

stories.title: What should stop an AI coding agent before it acts?
stories.author: suirindo
bullet_points: The article addresses the critical issue of safety mechanisms for AI coding agents.
It frames the safety discussion around three key questions, starting with 'Role preflight'.
This topic is relevant to the growing field of autonomous AI agents and software development.

stories.title: JetBrains open-sourced an agentic IDE where agents never touch your checkout
stories.author: slabb
bullet_points: JetBrains open-sourced Thinkrail, an agentic IDE built under the Apache-2.0 license.
The architecture isolates agent operations by confining each agent to its own Git worktree.
The project utilizes a graph of SPEC.md files as its source of truth, emphasizing decentralized, account-less operation.

stories.title: Your secrets don't need a git commit to leak into an AI tool
stories.author: cyclopt_dimitrisk
bullet_points: Secrets can leak into AI tools even without being committed to Git.
The article addresses the common developer practice of using pre-commit hooks and secret scanners.
It highlights a new security vulnerability related to the interaction between development workflows and AI tools.
